periods.time: Vermillion funeral night through the first representative-war exchanges
periods.label: 守护祖国并夺回友人的红莲皇女

name.jp: ステラ・ヴァーミリオン

status.current: has defeated John and flies toward Or-Gaule after confirming Lunaeyes rescued him
status.condition: uninjured and emotionally steadied by trust in Ikki and Lunaeyes
status.goal: save Vermillion, rescue John, punish Or-Gaule, and keep every promise she made

personality.summary: Proud, direct, deeply affectionate, and increasingly royal in her resolve to protect everyone without losing herself.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Lover and strongest rival; she fears losing him but chooses to trust his strength in battle.
relationships.john-kristoff-von-cobrand: Childhood friend she defeats with a bare-handed stop and Lunaeyes's message to break Or-Gaule's control path.
relationships.lunaeyes-vermillion: Older sister she admires; Stella opposes but ultimately respects Lunaeyes's determination to save John personally.
relationships.sirius-vermillion: Father whose country and expectations she carries as representative.
relationships.nene-saikyo: Teacher and teammate; Stella worries about her drunken prewar behavior but trusts her battlefield strength.
relationships.or-gaule: Enemy responsible for John's suffering and the Quedland tragedy; Stella heads to kill or stop him after reading his threads.

periods.summary: At the Vermillion funeral wake, Stella joins the people, protects Ikki's homeland food from takoyaki slander, and worries about Nene drinking before battle. After hearing of the League army's disaster against Naseem, she prays for the dead and tells Ikki that she no longer fears Naseem as she once did because the Crimson Princess is supported by her people. Her real fear is Ikki dying; after he vows to return alive, she accepts his kiss and chooses to trust him. At the start of the war, Naseem scatters the team. Stella initially tries to rescue Ikki from the fall, but John attacks on Golden Chariot. Remembering Lunaeyes's plea and trusting Ikki's strength, Stella focuses on John. She recognizes that Or-Gaule's puppet control is forcing John's body past its limits. To end it quickly she dismisses Lævateinn, confronts Trampling King's Road barehanded, and overpowers its fate-breaking charge because John has no true will while puppeteered. Stella drags him off the chariot and delivers Lunaeyes's scolding slap, sending him to the ground. After Lunaeyes personally reaches John and frees him, Stella confirms the rescue, admires her sister's courage, then senses Or-Gaule's thread network over Quedland and flies toward him with renewed anger.

key_events.summary: Confesses fear of losing Ikki and receives his promise to survive.
Is scattered into an aerial duel with John rather than rescuing Ikki.
Stops John's Golden Chariot barehanded and launches him toward Lunaeyes's intervention.
After John is rescued, tracks Or-Gaule's threads and later blocks his escape with dragon fire.
